dashboard.workerGetStartedAfter: kugira ngo wubake amanota y'ikizere yemejwe, hanyuma urebe

gigFeed.emptySaved: Nta murimo wabitse — kanda ku mutima kuri umurimo kugira ngo uwubike.

gigDetail.pendingReviewNotice: Uyu murimo utegereje kwemezwa n'ubuyobozi mbere yo kugaragarira abakozi.
gigDetail.approveInstructions: Reba amakuru avuzwe haruguru, hanyuma uwemeze kugira ngo ugaragarire abakozi cyangwa uwange.
gigDetail.messageClientHint: Ufite ibibazo kuri uyu murimo? Ohereza {{name}} ubutumwa.

wallet.title: Ipochi
wallet.subtitleClient: Kurikirana ibyo wishyuye abakozi ukoresheje Isoko Talents.
wallet.subtitleWorker: Kurikirana ibyo winjije ukoresheje Isoko Talents.
wallet.simulatedNotice: Isoko Talents ikoresha uburyo bwigana MTN Mobile Money kuri iyi demo — nta mafaranga nyayo atangwa.
wallet.noTransactions: Nta bikorwa by'imari burahaba — rangiza umurimo kugira ngo ubibone hano.
wallet.workerStep1Body: Saba umurimo ufunguye maze wemezwe n'ubuyobozi, bigatuma uhuzwa n'uwo mukorana.
wallet.workerStep2Body: Iyo wemeye, umukiliya yishyura mu bubiko. Ubona ko abitswe mbere yo gutangira.
wallet.workerStep3Body: Urangije, umukiliya aguha kode y’imibare 4. Uyinjije, amafaranga aba ayawe.
wallet.clientStep1Body: Sobanura akazi maze ushyireho ingengo y'imari. Ubuyobozi burabisuzuma mbere yo kubugaragariza abakozi.
wallet.clientStep2Body: Umukozi namara kwemera, ishyura na MoMo. Isoko ibika amafaranga kugeza akazi karangiye.
wallet.clientStep3Body: Wishimiye akazi, ha umukozi kode yo gusoza. Ibyo bituma yishyurwa.

settings.title: Igenamiterere
settings.subtitle: Genzura umwirondoro wawe rusange, kugaragara kw'aho uherereye, n'amakuru ya konti yawe.
settings.profileDescWorker: Amakuru yawe n'aho uherereye bigaragara ku mwirondoro wawe rusange, abakiriya bakabibona.
settings.profileDescOther: Amakuru yawe agaragara ku mwirondoro wawe rusange, abandi bakoresha bakabibona.
settings.securityDesc: Hindura ijambo ry'ibanga ukoresheje uburyo bumwe wakoresha iyo uribagiwe.
settings.exportDesc: Kuramo kopi y'ibyose Isoko Talents ifite kuri konti yawe — umwirondoro wawe, ubuhanga bwoherejwe, imirimo, imirimo mwahuriyeho, ubwishyu, ibitekerezo, n'ubutumwa — nk'idosiye ya JSON.

notifications.title: Amatangazo
notifications.desc: Amatangazo yo muri porogaramu ahora akora. Hitamo ubundi buryo bumwe bwo kumenyeshwa.
notifications.inAppAlways: Uzahora ubona amatangazo hano, uko waba wahisemo kose.
notifications.emailHint: Ku bijyanye no kwishyurwa, impinduka kuri konti, n'ibyemezo ku kazi kawe.
notifications.smsHint: Ku bijyanye no kwishyurwa, impinduka kuri konti, n'ibyemezo ku kazi kawe, binyuze mu butumwa bugufi.
notifications.smsPhoneInvalid: Andika nimero ya telefoni yo mu Rwanda itangirwa na 072, 073, 078 cyangwa 079.
notifications.smsCodeWrong: Iyo kode si yo. Usigaje amahirwe {{count}}.
notifications.smsCodeExpired: Iyi kode yarangiye. Saba indi nshya.
notifications.smsConsent: Niwemeza, uremera ko Isoko yohereza amatangazo kuri iyi nimero binyuze kuri Pindo, ikigo cyohereza ubutumwa bugufi mu Rwanda. Ushobora guhagarika ubutumwa bugufi hano igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
notifications.smsSender: Muri iki gihe cy'igerageza, ubutumwa buzaturuka kuri “{{sender}}” kandi butangire na “Isoko:”.
notifications.verifyPending: Nta meyili izoherezwa mbere y'uko wemeza iyi aderesi.
notifications.verifySent: Reba muri imeyili yawe umuhuza wo kwemeza.

skill.absent: Ubu bumenyi ntiburi kuri profayili ye

reason.categoryOnly: Akora uyu mwuga, nta bwihariye bwatanzwe

trust.title: Amanota y’ikizere
trust.provisional: Mushya kuri Isoko — nta bitekerezo birahari. Ntabwo ari amanota make, ni uko atagira isuzuma.
trust.penalty: Yagabanyijwe amanota {{points}}: akazi {{count}} yaretse amaze kwemera mu minsi 90 ishize.
trust.formulaNote: Uburyo bwo kubara {{version}}. Ibitekerezo bya vuba bifite uburemere bwinshi, kandi amateka maremare aruta igitekerezo kimwe.

matches.pendingWorkerPrompt: Watoranyijwe kuri aka kazi. Emeza ko uracyaboneka.
matches.pendingClientPrompt: Turategereje ko umukozi yemeza ko aboneka.
matches.declineExplainer: Aka kazi kazasubira ku isoko kugira ngo umukiriya atoranye undi.
matches.declineReasonPlaceholder: Impamvu (si ngombwa) — urugero: nari mfite akandi kazi
matches.alreadyReviewed: Wamaze gutanga isuzuma kuri aka kazi.

verification.captureHint: Fata ifoto y’akazi warangije, cyangwa wiyandikire ijwi usobanura icyo wakoze.
verification.micDenied: Mikoro ntiboneka. Reba uburenganzira bwa mushakisha, cyangwa ufate ifoto.
verification.needEvidence: Shyiraho ifoto cyangwa ijwi, cyangwa wandike umurongo.
verification.evidenceFingerprint: Buri dosiye ifite ikimenyetso cyayo bwite, bityo ibimenyetso ntibishobora guhindurwa nyuma y'icyemezo.

passport.title: Pasiporo y’ubumenyi
passport.explainer: Umurongo na kode ya QR byerekana ubumenyi bwawe bwemejwe ku muntu wese, ndetse n’utari kuri Isoko. Wereke umukiriya abashe kubigenzura ako kanya.
passport.shareNote: Umuntu wese ufite uyu murongo ashobora kubona ubumenyi bwawe n’amateka y’akazi. Ushobora kuwukuraho igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
passport.verifiedNow: Byemejwe: aya makuru ahuye n’ayabitswe ubu.
passport.recordChanged: Aya makuru yahindutse kuva pasiporo yakorwa. Ayariho ubu ari hasi.
passport.footer: Ubumenyi bwemejwe bwasuzumwe n’abasuzuma bahawe akazi mu buryo bwikora, umukozi atabashobora gutoranya. Abasuzuma ntibavugwa amazina, kugira ngo bagume bigenga.

income.title: Icyemezo cy’amafaranga winjije
income.explainer: Inyandiko ishyizweho umukono y’amafaranga wahembwe binyuze kuri Isoko. Ababaguriza na serivisi za mobile money barabigenzura, ibyo akazi k’amafaranga y’intoki kadashobora kwerekana.

common.themeHint: Hitamo nk’iya sisitemu yawe, cyangwa uhitemo imwe ihoraho.
common.noMatches: Nta guhuzwa birahari — tanga akazi cyangwa uhuzwe na ko mbere.
common.mapHint: Utudomo twerekana aho akazi kari. Kanda kamwe ukafungure.

review.confidenceHint: Niba udahamya, bivuge — undi musuzuma azazanwa aho kukubireka wenyine.

skills.specialisationHint: Si ngombwa. Guhitamo bidufasha kuguhuza n’akazi kakwiye.
skills.requiredLevelHint: Si ngombwa. Abakozi bari hasi y’uru rwego baracyashobora gusaba — bashyirwa hasi ku rutonde, ntibahishwe.

experience.title: Uburambe bwawe
experience.hint: Bwira abakiriya ibyo wakoze mbere. Bigaragara ku mwirondoro wawe rusange.
experience.summaryPlaceholder: Urugero: imyaka itanu nsana telefoni i Nyamirambo, cyane cyane ibirahure n’aho bashyira umuriro.

credentials.title: Ibimenyetso by’ubumenyi

tierHelp.self_declared: Umukozi yatubwiye ko akora ibi. Nta wurabigenzura.
tierHelp.document_sighted: Usuzuma yarebye icyemezo umukozi yatanze. Ibyo byemeza ko inyandiko yabonywe — si ukugenzura niba icyemezo ubwacyo ari ukuri.
tierHelp.peer_reviewed: Abasuzuma bigenga barebye ibimenyetso by’akazi barabyemeza. Abasuzuma bahabwa akazi mu buryo bwikora, umukozi ntashobora kubatoranya.
tierHelp.work_earned: Byubatswe ku kazi karangiye kandi gasuzumwe kuri Isoko.

credentials.addHint: Fata ifoto y’icyemezo cyanditse cyangwa ushyireho PDF. Usuzuma azemeza ko yakibonye. Ntidushobora kugenzura icyemezo ubwacyo.
credentials.certTitlePlaceholder: Urugero: TVET Urwego rwa 3 muri Electronics
credentials.declareHint: Bwira abakiriya icyo ukora. Ushobora kongeraho ibimenyetso nyuma — ubumenyi butagira ibimenyetso buracyagaragara, bwanditseho ko wivugiye.
credentials.honestNotice: Isoko yemeza ko usuzuma yabonye icyemezo cyawe. Ntiyemeza ko icyemezo ari ukuri, kandi ntiyigera ibivuga.

offline.offline: Nta murandasi ufite. Igikorwa {{count}} cyabitswe, kizoherezwa nubwo uzagaruka kuri interineti.
offline.offline_other: Nta murandasi ufite. Ibikorwa {{count}} byabitswe, bizoherezwa nubwo uzagaruka kuri interineti.
offline.savedOffline: Byabitswe. Bizoherezwa igihe uzagaruka kuri interineti.

verifyEmail.successBody: Ubu uzahabwa amatangazo ya Isoko Talents kuri imeyili.
verifyEmail.failedBody: Ashobora kuba yarangiye cyangwa yakoreshejwe. Saba undi mushya muri Igenamiterere.
verifyEmail.missingToken: Uyu muhuza wuzuye. Ongera ufungure umuhuza uri muri imeyili yawe.

escrow.fundBody: Ishyura {{amount}} RWF ubu. Isoko izabibika, ibihe umukozi ari uko akazi karangiye.
escrow.waitingFunding: Dutegereje ko umukiliya yishyura mu bubiko. Uzamenyeshwa amafaranga amaze kubikwa.
escrow.secured: {{amount}} RWF bibitswe mu bubiko kuri aka kazi.
escrow.codeHint: Iha umukozi iyi kode akazi karangiye. Kuyinjiza bituma yishyurwa.
escrow.releaseConfirmBody: Amafaranga ajya kuri {{name}} kandi akazi kakemezwa ko karangiye. Ntibishobora gusubizwa inyuma.
escrow.enterCodeLabel: Injiza kode y'umukiliya kugira ngo usoze akazi
escrow.wrongCode: Iyo kode si yo. Usigaje amahirwe {{count}}.
escrow.locked: Kode yafunzwe kubera kwibeshya kenshi. Saba umukiliya akwishyure muri porogaramu.
escrow.reportDone: Umukiliya ntahari? Menyesha ko akazi karangiye
escrow.reportDoneHint: Umukiliya azasabwa kukwishyura. Natabikora, uzishyurwa ku wa {{date}}.
escrow.workDoneClient: Umukozi yavuze ko akazi karangiye. Azishyurwa ku wa {{date}} keretse umwishyuye mbere.

quote.priceHelp: Ingengo y'imari y'umukiliya ni {{budget}} RWF. Vuga igiciro ukwiye. Igiciro mwumvikanyeho ni cyo umukiliya ashyira mu bubiko.
quote.notePlaceholder: Urugero: harimo ibikoresho, nshobora gutangira ku wa mbere

receipt.title: Inyemezabwishyu
receipt.scanHint: Sikana ugenzure iyi nyemezabwishyu mu nyandiko za Isoko.
receipt.notFoundHelp: Reba nimero iri ku nyemezabwishyu yacapwe. Inyemezabwishyu zibaho gusa ku mafaranga yahawe umukozi.

dispute.openBody: Ubwishyu bubikwa mu gihe abanyamuryango batatu ba Isoko, batigeze bakorana n'umwe muri mwe, bafata icyemezo.
dispute.detailsPlaceholder: Sobanura ibyo mwumvikanye n'ibyabaye. Abahuza barabisoma.
dispute.frozen: Ikirego kirafunguye. Ubwishyu burahagaritswe kugeza gifashweho icyemezo.
dispute.title: Ibirego
dispute.subtitle: Amafaranga ari mu bubiko yagiweho impaka, n'abahuza babifataho icyemezo.
dispute.addSidePlaceholder: Sobanura ibyo mwumvikanye n'ibyabaye ku ruhande rwawe.
dispute.deadline: Kizafatwaho icyemezo bitarenze {{date}}, bitabaye ibyo umuyobozi akabikora
dispute.rationalePlaceholder: Kubera iki? Bizamenyeshwa impande zombi icyemezo kimaze gufatwa.
dispute.panelNote: Batoranyijwe ku bushake mu banyamuryango {{count}} bujuje ibisabwa.

chat.tooBig: Ifoto igomba kuba munsi ya MB 10.

jobPhotos.title: Amafoto y'akazi
jobPhotos.hint: Agera kuri 3. Agaragara mu mateka y'akazi kawe akazi kamaze kwishyurwa.
jobPhotos.failed: Ntibyashyizweho. Amafoto agomba kuba ari munsi ya MB 10.

rejection.title: Kubera iki wanze ubu busabe?
rejection.help: Umukozi arabibona, kugira ngo amenye icyo yanoza.
rejection.notePlaceholder: Hari icyo wongeraho? (si ngombwa, umukozi arakibona)
rejection.breakdownHelp: Hakurikijwe ubumenyi. Kwangwa kenshi kubera ubumenyi bike mu bumenyi bumwe byerekana aho amahugurwa akenewe.

rates.basis_paid: Bishingiye ku kazi {{count}} kishyuwe kuri Isoko.
rates.basis_posted: Bishingiye ku ngengo {{count}} zatanzwe; akazi kishyuwe ntikaraba kenshi.
rates.belowClient: Ibi biri munsi y’ibyo akazi nk’aka gakunze kwishyurwa. Abakozi beza bashobora kubyirengagiza.
rates.belowWorker: Igiciro cyawe kiri munsi y’ibisanzwe. Reba ko gihagije ku gihe n’ibikoresho byawe.
rates.belowAdmin: Biri munsi y'ibisanzwe muri uyu mwuga.
